messages:
Carmen Diaz: Pulling together the follow-ups from the ingress-surge postmortem. We noted a recurring pattern across three incidents where transient spikes routed to cold-backed model replicas and caused cascade retries + cost spike. I listed action items below 1: please claim and add Jira links. Goal: owners + due dates by Fri EOD.

Carmen Diaz: Action items: 1) Add anomaly detector to flag ingress spikes and auto-label incidents. 2) Harden fallback order so we prefer warm replicas / local cache. 3) Add a cost-surge alert that ties to tenant budgets. 4) Backfill tagged incidents from last 9 months and surface recurrence dashboard. 5) Update runbook with explicit handoff steps and RACI for fallback escalations.

Ethan Moore: I'll take #1 (anomaly detector + auto-label). I'll prototype a simple threshold/percentile rule and schedule it for staging.

Ethan Moore: Jira: REM-5601 "ingress anomaly detector + auto-label". ETA: 10 days. Linking a quick rule doc in the ticket.

Li Wei: I'll own #2 (fallback order). We need to codify preference for warm replicas and add a health-check weight. I'll open RFC and a follow-up ticket for rollout gating.

Li Wei: Ticket: RUNTIME-7219 "fallback ordering: prefer warm/local cache". Will include rollout checklist.

Grace Kim: I'll take #3 (cost-surge alert by tenant). Need product to confirm budget windows. @Carmen can you loop PM?

Grace Kim: Created ticket: COST-4420 "per-tenant cost-surge alert". Leaving assignment pending PM input.

Carmen Diaz: Looping PM now. Also I'll volunteer to help with #4 backfill queries if Ops grants read to archived incidents.

RemediationBot: Action scheduled: export incident events (last 9 months) to analytics-bucket (job 2415007200). Reminder set for owners check-in in 72 hours (2415009900).

Ethan Moore: For the dashboard (#4) I suggest a recurrence heatmap grouped by tenant + trigger type. I'll add a mock in REM-5601 once data's exported.

Li Wei: For the runbook (#5) propose this RACI: Responsible = oncall owner, Accountable = runtime lead, Consulted = product, Informed = infra-sre. Will add contact rotation and a short escalation script.

Grace Kim: ACK RACI. Also recommend adding a verification step: a canary that simulates a warm-replica failover to validate fallback order. I'll add as subtask in COST-4420.

Ethan Moore: Small tooling ask: add incident label "ingress-spike-fallback" when detector fires so we can query recurrence easily. I'll add PR to TOOLS once REM-5601 proves rule shape.

Carmen Diaz: Summary: owners assigned (REM-5601 Ethan, RUNTIME-7219 Li, COST-4420 Grace), export job scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll publish the owners matrix and drop these into the remediation tracker after PM confirms budget shape. Thanks.

Grace Kim: ACK.

Li Wei: ACK.

Ethan Moore: ACK.

Carmen Diaz: Closing for now 1 1 ping here if anything blocks tickets or access rights.
